title: CuratedItemFile
description: One curated item file (domain-model.md §15.1 header, kind fields, `[[param]]`, `[[effect]]`).

ability_source.description:
Buffs: the source is a Warframe ability, an augment or a Helminth-subsumed ability
(`ItemKind::Buff.ability_source`; 04 §4.2 `ability_source` and §5.7 "Source kind"; 05 §13.1). Addition,
contract review DC-16.

default_caster.description:
Buffs: caster of a pick without one (04 §4.2 `caster`; `ally` for T-13 Roar, spec 00 §6.1 T-37). Addition,
CONTRACTS.md T01d.

duration_scaled.description: Buffs: durations × Dur_e of the caster (04 §4.2 `dur_scaled`, E-4.10). Addition, CONTRACTS.md T01d.

excluded_lines.description:
Conditional stat lines of the upstream text that no effect of the file implements: excluded from every
bucket, never applied as unconditional, and listed in the data-build report (04 §5.3 "Uncatalogued
conditional lines"; `DataKey::CheckConditionalLineExcluded`). Addition, CONTRACTS.md T01d.

id.description: UniqueName: the join key (`"wfd:…"` for our items).

inspiration_key.description: Buffs and custom stats: the inspiration's link key (`"o.r"`, `"p.a"`).

inspiration_name.description: Only for link import; never a data source.

name.description: Must equal the catalogue English name (checked).

noncounting.description:
Sets: members that never count (`set_noncounting` of 09 E-9.40: Mecha Empowered), by uniqueName; T18 fills
`SetDef.noncounting`. Addition, contract review DC-26.

scope.description: Default scope of every effect whose own scope is the default.

status.description:
verified | draft | unmodelled | no_damage_effect (`auto` and `stale` are pipeline states, rejected by the
validator in authoring files).

strength_scaled.description: Buffs: value = listed(rank) · Str of the caster (04 E-4.10).

subsumable.description: Buffs: offered in the Helminth slot (09 §10).

toggle.description: Buffs: the toggle the buff implements (`"T-13"`).

$comment: GENERATED by `cargo xtask gen-schema` (wfd-model) — never edit by hand. Curated TOML files of pipeline.md §6.1. The root describes the item files; the other files are described under $defs: weapon_mod/**, weapon_arcane/**, frame_mod/**, aura/**, frame_arcane/**, shard/**, stance/**, set/**, buff/**, custom/** → CuratedItemFile; incarnon/** → IncarnonFamilyFile; rules/mult_groups.toml → MultGroupsFile; rules/slot_layout.toml → SlotLayoutFile; rules/riven_traits.toml → RivenTraitsFile; rules/riven_formula.toml → RivenFormulaFile; rules/body_parts.toml → BodyPartsFile; rules/special_dr.toml → SpecialDrFile; rules/toggles.toml → TogglesFile; rules/factions.toml → FactionsFile; rules/categories.toml → CategoriesFile; rules/helminth.toml → HelminthFile; rules/frames.toml → FramesFile; rules/attack_roles.toml → AttackRolesFile; rules/stat_lines.toml → StatLinesFile; rules/melee/heavy_class.toml → HeavyClassFile; rules/melee/heavy_kappa.toml → HeavyKappaFile; rules/melee/attack_triggers.toml → AttackTriggersFile; rules/melee/stance_co.toml → StanceCoFile; rules/melee/finishers.toml → FinishersFile; rules/melee/combo_specials.toml → ComboSpecialsFile; rules/game_constants.toml → GameConstantsFile; overrides/weapons/** → WeaponOverrideFile; overrides/attacks/*.toml → AttackOverrideFile; overrides/enemies/*.toml → EnemyOverrideFile; overrides/progenitor.toml → ProgenitorFile; aliases/enemies.toml → EnemyAliasFile.

AttackFireOverride.description:
Firing overrides of one attack (06 §4.3 per-attack rows), keyed by the data `AttackName`; absent fields keep the
data value.

charge_fixed.description: Charge time not affected by mods (Phantasma; 06 E-6.4).

charge_time.description: Charge time CT0 when the data lacks it (Vulcax 1.0; 06 §5.3, §4.2).

gauge.description: Gauge-gated attack (06 §6.7, E-6.14a; also adds the role `gauge_gated`).

magazine_override.description: Incarnon form magazine without data (Miter 20, Stug 120; 06 §6.6).

roles.description: Firing roles added to the attack (`reload_triggered`, `whole_magazine`, `returning`; 06 §9.5, §6.4).

sniper_combo.description: Sniper combo (06 §7.2; exclusions: Arca Scisco, Knell with `min` absent).

AttackGroupOverride.description: An attack group of an [`AttackOverrideFile`] (`AttackGroup` by data `AttackName`).

AttackOverrideFile.description:
`overrides/attacks/<weapon-slug>.toml` (owner and reader T18): the hand-authored attack data of 02 §4.10
(`[[attack]]` records with `[[attack.forced]]`), parent links for the inconsistent `AttackParentIndex` cases
(06 E-6.23, §9.1), roles of gated children (06 §9.1-9.2) and T-22 comb groups (pipeline.md §5.3). Firing
overrides are in [`WeaponOverrideFile`]. Addition, contract review M-6, DC-18.

group.description: T-22 combinable groups and parent + child sums by data `AttackName` (CD-12).

AttackPred.description: Conditions on the resolved attack (formula, evaluated in every mode).

oneOf.description: The resolved stat is below x.
The resolved stat is at least x.

AttackRecord.description: One 02 §4.10 attack record, keyed by the data `AttackName`; absent fields keep the data value.

no_parent.description: The attack has no parent although the data links one (06 §9.1).

radial_parent_part.description: E-2.8, E-2.10 (role `radial_parent_part`; only on a child of a direct attack, data-build check).

roles.description: Roles added (`zoom_only`, `headshot_only` of 06 §9.1-9.2, and `stun_gated`, the stun gate of 06 E-6.24).

shot.description: Only attacks of this shot type.

AttackRolesFile.description: `rules/attack_roles.toml` (pipeline.md §5.3; T18): regex rules on attack names → roles.

Attenuation.description: Attenuation (max damage per instance, 05 §15.1); `p_att = None` = unknown parameter (result flagged).

mdps_frac.description:
Max damage per second as a fraction of max health (05 §15.2: Hemocyte 0.20, Eidolons 1.00). Stored for a later
model only: no stage reads it (MDPS is "not formulated yet"); `None` = not documented. Addition, CONTRACTS.md
T03b review fixes.

Battery.description: Battery recharge (06 §5.7): delay after the last shot, delay when empty, rounds per second.

delay.description: Recharge delay after the last shot δ_rech (s, `ReloadDelay`).

Binding.description: Number binding to the upstream text (`"n1%"`, `"n2"`, `"n3x"`, domain-model.md §15.2).

faction_heads.description: Faction defaults of 05 §4.3 F (first matching row; a row with empty `factions` is the fallback).

head_wp_factor.description: k_wp: weak-point damage factor on heads (02 E-7, `ΣWP` × 1.5 on the head).

BuffGroup.description:
Buff groups (curated `buff/<group>/`): a UI grouping, not the source kind of 05 §13.1 (that is
`ItemKind::Buff.ability_source`).

oneOf.description:
Squadmates' buffs. Never Corrosive Projection or Shield Disruption: a squadmate's aura enters only through
T-23 (`EnemySetup.squad_cp`, `squad_shield_disruption`; 05 E-5.10, E-5.16), so a buff item would count it twice
(the validator T19 rejects such a buff; contract review M-19).

CasterKind.description: Who casts a buff by default (`ItemKind::Buff.default_caster`; 04 §4.2 field `caster`, §4.4).

oneOf.description: The build's own frame.
A squadmate (Strength and Duration 1.0 unless the document says otherwise).

CategoriesFile.description:
`rules/categories.toml` (09 §3.1-3.2, wiki `Mods/itemCompatibility/data`; T03b): category bits, the
compatibility chains per weapon slot and class, type-name normalisation and stance tags.

stance_tag_rename.description:
Stance-tag normalisation applied to mod and weapon tags before comparison (09 §3.2, EC-09-21:
`"BAYONET" = "BAYONET_STANCE"`). Addition, CONTRACTS.md T03b review fixes.

name.description: Category name (`"Assault Rifle"`, `"Daggers"` …, the compatibility-tree node of 09 §3.1).

fire_rate_below.description: Applies when the attack's fire rate is below this (1/s).

Choice.description: One choice of a choice parameter.

label.description: Label key; `None` = derived from the value.

ClassChainRow.description: One row of the compatibility-chain table of 09 §3.1.

class.description: `M:Weapons.Class`; empty = any class of the slot.

weapons.description: Weapons with their own chain (Exalted rows: Artemis Bow, Neutralizer …).

ComboSpecialsFile.description: `rules/melee/combo_specials.toml`: k_tier, M_cap, M_bcap, D0_cb overrides, innate Initial Combo (07 §6).

ComboType.description: Combo types of 07 E-7.0b, in the order of that equation (array index of `MeleeTables.combos`).

CompressionMode.description:
Bucket of Primary Compression on an attack (04 §3.1, the "Compression Effectiveness" column of
`W:Primary_Compression`): "Multiplies" attacks get the G_F factor, "Adds" attacks the same value in A. The attack
data carries the mode next to eff_a (`Attack.compression_mode` beside `Attack.compression_eff`); the default is
`multiplies` ("1.00 for most"). Addition, contract review DC-8 (CONTRACTS.md "Contract review fixes (model-core)"
and "(model-records)").

oneOf.description: The page's "Adds": the value enters A (Ambassador and Battacor alt-fire, Opticor, Trumna …).
The page's "Multiplies": one factor `1 + value` of the G_F group.

CondRepr.description:
Readable form of [`Cond`]: a table with exactly one of `trigger`, `target`, `shot`, `attack`, `all`, `any`
(`chance`, `hit_unit`, `bind_chance`, `chance_rank` only with `trigger`); the empty table is `Always`.

ConsumeOn.description: The buff is used up by the next qualifying use (04 §4.2 `consume_on`).

ControlOption.description: One option of a select control.

ControlType.description:
Control types. Every kind but `Custom` is generic: the value at the toggle's single `field` path has the
control's shape (bool, number, option value, number or `null`; for `OptionalNumber` also a one-member object).

oneOf.description: A number in model units (fractions) shown as a percentage.
One of `options`; a toggle whose `default` is `null` is optional: `null` = off, offered as an extra choice.

A number or `null` (off). One-member-object convention: where the model value at `field` is an object with
one numeric member (T-08 `toggles.stealth = { rank? }`, T-09 `toggles.heavy = { start_combo }`), `null` is off,
any object is on, the control edits that member (`min`, `max`, `step` bound it) and switching on writes `{}`,
the member's model default (the weapon's maximum rank; start combo 12). Contract review T03b-R6.

The value is structured (an object, a list or several paths) and the frontend renders it with a component of
its own, keyed by the toggle id (frontend.md §4); `min`, `max`, `step` and `options`, when present, describe
its main scalar input (T-05's N, T-24's v10). Addition, CONTRACTS.md T03b review fixes.

CounterEvent.description: Event that raises a counter (TOML `"hit"`, `{ input = "light" }`, `"any_input"`, `"throw"`).

oneOf.description: One input of this kind (07 §7.5 `input_start`).

One per light, slide, aerial or wall input, whatever its number of strikes or enemies (every [`InputKind`];
heavies and slams add none): Melee Animosity (04 §5.4, 07 §7.5). Addition, contract review DC-1.

CounterReset.description: Event that resets a counter (TOML `{ crit_tier_at_least = 2 }`, `"heavy"`, `"other_input"`, `"reload"`).

oneOf.description:
The weapon reloads (04 §5.3 Hata-Satya `reset_on = (on_reload, 1)`; holstering is not modelled). Addition,
CONTRACTS.md T01d.

CrowdControl.description:
Crowd-control proc names of stance data that are not status types (07 §4.1, 03 table 4.2; `Finisher` and
`Disarmed` per OQ-715).

CuratedKind.description: Header `kind` of a curated item file (checked against the catalogue kind).

oneOf.description: Set bonus effects (`set/<slug>.toml`; `id` is the PE mod-set path).

CuratedPerk.description: One perk of an Incarnon family file.

excluded_lines.description:
Conditional stat lines of the upstream text that no effect of the file implements: excluded from every
bucket, never applied as unconditional, and listed in the data-build report (04 §5.3 "Uncatalogued
conditional lines"; `DataKey::CheckConditionalLineExcluded`). Addition, CONTRACTS.md T01d.

index.description: Position in the evolution's perk list.

DotInheritance.description:
DoT inheritance of a multiplier group: whether the group's factor enters the DoT **seed** (03 E-3.4, 04 §3.4).
It says nothing about factors applied at tick time: `TargetVuln` groups are `None` here and still multiply every
DoT tick when the tick lands (05 §13: V "never enters the weapon side or the DoT seed" and applies to "every DoT
tick at tick time", CD-05). Doc addition, CONTRACTS.md T03b review fixes.

oneOf.description: Part of the DoT seed.
Seed and M_dot (Mecha, Vauban).

DrClass.description: Class-conditional damage reduction (05 §14): per class of instance.

radial_or_melee.description: DR of radial or melee instances (fraction).

EffectDefRepr.description:
Readable form of [`EffectDef`]: the target is one of the keys `stat`, `element`, `faction`, `mult`, `mechanic`
(with `params`).

oneOf.description: Reviewed curated entry with sources.
Tier-1 stat-line import or tier-2 spec-table ingestion, all lines mapped, validators clean.
Scaffolded or partially reviewed.
Upstream text changed since review.
Known to affect damage, not encoded yet (also every catalogue item with no effects).
Recoil, zoom without stat change, utility.

ElemOrder.description:
Element ordering class (domain-model.md §13; 01 §4.10.1 positions, E-1.8 sub-indices). 04 §4.2 `position`
values: `mod_slot` = `Slot` (and `Riven` for riven rows), `warframe_arcane` = `WarframeArcane`, `innate_group` =
`Innate`, `non_combining` = `NonCombining`.

oneOf.description:
The slot the item sits in, at the slot's `SlotDef.element_order`: main slots 0-7, exilus 8, the weapon arcane
slots and the Incarnon perk slots 9 (sub-index n for `arcane<n>`, the evolution t (2-5) for `inc<t>`, so no
two slots tie; 01 §4.10.1, E-1.8; contract review T03b-R2, UNVERIFIED until the 01 spec round confirms).
The riven's slot, lines bottom-up.
After modded elements, with innate and progenitor elements, in HCET order.
Added to its type after combination (01 §4.10.3).

Warframe-arcane elements (Theorem Demulcent): position 10, after every weapon-side position and before the
innate group, sub-index = the HCET index of the element (HEA 0, COL 1, ELE 2, TOX 3); 01 §4.10.1, E-1.8,
TV-01-38; 04 §4.2 `position = warframe_arcane`. Addition, CONTRACTS.md T01d.

unique_name.description: The uniqueName the enemy keeps (its old synthetic name).

wiki.description: The current wiki entry, as a 05 §4.1 id (`"<sub-module>:<Name>"`).

EnemyAliasFile.description:
`aliases/enemies.toml` (owner T29, read by T18): wiki enemy renames. An enemy's uniqueName is synthetic
(`wfd:enemy/<wiki sub-module>/<slug of the wiki Name>`, domain-model.md §2), so a renamed wiki entry keeps its
stable key only through a row here. Addition, contract review DC-18.

EnemyOverrideFile.description:
`overrides/enemies/<slug>.toml` (owner T29, read by T18): the hand part records of 05 §4.3 and §4.5 for the
listed enemies (Juggernaut maw h = 4, Hemocyte's default part, Isolator Bursa front, Scaldra `part_dr`).
Record-level hand fields (immunities, caps, DR, flags) are `rules/special_dr.toml` rows ([`EnemyRuleRow`]).
Addition, contract review M-6, DC-18.

default_part.description: Name of the default part (`BodyPart.is_default`; used for `body` hits and radial instances).

replace_parts.description:
`true`: the parts below replace the parsed parts; `false` (default): each patches the parsed part of the
same name, or is added when none has it.

EnemyRuleRow.description:
A hand-authored enemy row of 05 §4.4-4.5: the listed enemies (05 §4.1 ids, `"infestation:Juggernaut"`) get these
fields. Absent fields leave the data value.

bolstered_og_factor.description: `Enemy.bolstered_og_factor` (05 §7.5; Techrot Babau 0.25). Addition, contract review M-17.

party_scaling.description: `Enemy.party_scaling`: P_1 … P_4, or more entries (P_5, P_6); the last entry clamps (contract review M-17).

EquipmentClass.description: Equipment class of 09 E-9.1 and the table of 09 §2.2 (a slot layout per class).

ExcludedLine.description:
A conditional upstream stat line that the file deliberately does not implement (04 §5.3 exclusion rule):
`{ line = "<the line as the upstream text writes it>", reason = "…" }`.

line.description: The line, as the upstream text writes it.

reason.description: Why it has no effect (out of scope, no damage effect, no source for the condition …).

factions.description: Faction slugs; empty = every other faction.

head_mult.description: Head multiplier P_part of the factions' heads.

headcrit.description: Headcrit factor h of the factions' heads.

exceptions.description: Modifier differences from the wiki table that are intended, each with a citation.

wiki_names.description: Data strings that map to the faction (05 §4.2: `"The Murmur"` → murmur).

FactionSelRepr.description: Readable form of [`FactionSel`]: `"any"` or a list of faction slugs.

FactionsFile.description:
`rules/factions.toml` (05 §4.2, §5.1, §6.2, 01 §4.10.4, D-008; T03b): faction identities, data-string
normalisation, bane relations, weakness elements, scaling class and documented exceptions to the ingested
modifier table.

FinisherRow.description: A row of table 9-E (07 §9.11): finisher multipliers per kind as hit splits.

weapons.description:
Weapons the row is for (empty = every weapon of `class`). Set on the rows of the exalted weapons that
`W:Finisher` lists by name (Exalted Blade, Valkyr Talons; 07 §9.11), which share the class `ExaltedWeapon`
(addition, CONTRACTS.md T03c).

oneOf.description: Every instance of the attack (an unconditional hand-authored forced proc, 02 §4.10).
Target distance (T-27) at most this many metres.
Non-radial instances only.
Full charge (06 charge state).
The last shot of the magazine ("upon depleting mag", 06 last-shot flag).
While aiming (T-38; T-02 class b).

ForcedCount.description: A forced proc count (02 §4.10 `{ type, count }`).

ForcedProcRule.description:
A conditional or corrected forced proc of an attack (02 §4.10 `[[attack.forced]]`, E-2.14). JSON
`{ "condition": "direct_hit", "procs": [{ "type": "SLA", "count": 1 }], "replaces_data": false }`.

replaces_data.description: The data's unconditional forced proc of the same type is removed (correction rows: Evensong).

oneOf.description: Cedo alt-fire explosion: two procs, the second uniform over HEA, COL, ELE, TOX (D-202).
Evensong: 7 Puncture instead of the data's 2.
Nukor and Kuva Nukor Microwave on every hit (OQ-215).

passive.description:
The frame passive's effects (`Frame::passives`; 04 §5.11, §5.6): `[[frame.passive]]`. Addition, contract
review DC-14.

variant_of.description: Prime and Umbra variants (09 E-9.32 H6).

FramesFile.description: `rules/frames.toml` (09 §2.2, AD-26; T03b): aura slot overrides and variant links.

GameConstantsFile.description:
`rules/game_constants.toml` (`Rules.game_constants`): named game values that no dedicated table carries (Steel
Path ×2.5, Eximus steps …), one `[[constant]]` row each with its citation, so that T18 never hard-codes a game
value (I-1). Owner: T03b (CONTRACTS.md). Addition, contract review DC-19.

GaugeSpec.description: Gauge-gated attack (06 E-6.14a): charged by kills, one use from the fresh state (Battacor: 3 charges).

charges.description: Charges of a full gauge (Battacor 3); the fresh state holds one full gauge.

HeavyClassRow.description: A row of table 9-A (07 §9.1): heavy totals T_{class,h}, explicit breakdowns, typical wind-up.

breakdown.description: Explicit per-hit breakdown of heavy 1 and 2 (empty = none given).

total.description:
T_{class,1}, T_{class,2}. A class whose 9-A row is "–" (Bayonet) has no row: σ_h = 1 by E-7.40 rule 2, the
same as for a "–" entry (the curated TOML cannot write `None`; CONTRACTS.md "Contract review fixes
(model-records)", T03c-2).

wind_up.description: Typical wind-up (s); the weapon's `WindUp` field wins.

HeavyStrike.description: One strike of a heavy attack.

cc.description: Crowd-control names kept on the hit record (07 §4.1; addition, CONTRACTS.md T01a).

mult.description: Damage multiplier H_j of the strike (κ_w applied).

HelminthRules.description: Helminth restriction (09 E-9.32): restricted buffs R and the host of each frame.

hosts.description: Host(frame): frame uniqueName → the frame's native buff that conflicts.

restricted.description: R = {Eclipse, Roar, Xata's Whisper} as buff uniqueNames.

HitFilter.description: Hit part of a scope. Empty lists accept every kind and body part.

body_part.description: Gate bound to T-03, never assumed.

flags.description:
The instance carries every listed flag (07 §7.5 instance flags: `tennokai` for the Tennokai mods, 04 §5.3,
"Tennokai attacks only"). A gate, never assumed. Addition, contract review DC-6.

min_distance.description:
The scenario's target distance d (T-27) is strictly greater than this many metres (Spring-Loaded Broadhead 15,
Range Advantage 10; 04 §3.2, §5.3: "a target distance (T-27) … applies only to instances that have that
property, in every mode"). A gate, never assumed. Addition, contract review DC-7.

outcome.description:
Hit-outcome gate on the instance's own rolls (domain-model.md §11.1; no 04 catalogue row uses it since Laetum
Overwhelming Attrition became the `on_plain_hit` trigger, D-410).

HitUnit.description: What one "hit" is for on-hit triggers and counters (04 §4.1-4.2).

oneOf.description: Each pellet instance (default).
All pellets of one shot count once.
Every damage instance, extra hits included.

One per melee input (light, slide, aerial or wall input), whatever its number of strikes or enemies (04 §4.1
`hit_unit = input`, Melee Animosity; 07 `input_start`). Addition, CONTRACTS.md T01d.

native.description: Native Incarnon weapon (5 evolutions) instead of a Genesis (4), 09 E-9.60.

InputKind.description: Kind of a melee input (07 §7.5 `input_start`): the inputs that count for Melee Animosity and Tennokai.

KohmSpec.description: Kohm family spooling pellets (06 E-6.18): `P_max` (12 or 5) and the start fraction `FR0(single)/FR0(full)`.

max_pellets.description: P_max, the pellet cap of the spool (12 or 5).

Lingering.description: Lingering child (06 E-6.25): effect duration D_e and tick rate FR_child.

MagazineOverride.description: Magazine override of a [`WeaponOverrideFile`]; absent fields keep the data value.

battery.description: Battery recharge instead of a reload (06 §5.7; exalted `battery`).

MechOn.description: The `on` parameter of the kinds that have one (readable form; checked per kind).

oneOf.description: Addition, contract review DC-4.

MechanicParamsRepr.description:
Union of every kind's parameters: the readable `[effect.params]` table. [`Mechanic::from_params`] checks that
only the fields of the kind are present and fills defaults.

MeleeClass.description:
Wiki `Class` of melee weapons: the 28 stanceless classes of 07 table 9-A (Bayonet included), the data
class `"Exalted Weapon"` (07 E-7.0b) and archmelee weapons (09 E-9.1; 07 OQ-737).

MeleeTriggerRow.description:
A row of table 9-C (07 §9.7): which trigger spawns which data attack. In `MeleeRules` the row names its weapons;
in `MeleeData.triggers` it is the weapon's own row with `attack_idx` resolved.

attack.description: The data attack name (`AttackName` of the weapon record).

heavy_bonus.description: Heavy-only A members and crit doubling.

heavy_combo.description: × M_h and spends with its heavy.

oneOf.description: A `Ranged` entry of a combo (input index when the combo has several Ranged entries).
Heavy h (None = both heavies).

MessageKey.description: An i18n message key (`"cap.exceeded"`, `"param.value"`). JSON: a string.

MultGroupDef.description: A multiplier group (`data/curated/rules/mult_groups.toml`): members add, groups multiply.

dot.description: Seed inheritance only ([`DotInheritance`]); tick-time application follows `stage` (05 §13 for `TargetVuln`).

twice_on_two_bucket.description: Eclipse, Garuda on two-bucket melee projectiles (04 §3.4).

vuln.description:
TargetVuln groups only: types and layers the group multiplies (05 E-5.19). A mask without `layers` is health
only and one without `types` is every type ([`VulnMask`], 05 §13); a group on every layer (custom p.x,
Molecular Prime) lists `layers = ["OG", "SH", "HP"]`.

oneOf.description: `mult_other` G (ST-5), multiplies the adding CO term.
`mult_final_omitted` G_F (ST-4), omitted by the adding CO term (E-11, D-058).

`M_son` of `Part` (E-7, 02 E-2.10): inherited by DoT through `Part_dot = Part` (D-095, 03 §9.2; use
`dot = "inherit"`). Members are weak-spot sources that multiply as powers (domain-model.md §14). Doc corrected,
contract review DC-25.
Multiplicative members of `vuln[ℓ][t]` V (ST-8, 05 E-5.19), masked by the group's `vuln`.

A target-side status-chance factor of M_sc,t (02 E-2.11 `sc_vuln`: `Π_v (1 + v)`, one factor `1 + Σ members`
per group): Pageflight, Dante's passive (×1.5: value 0.5), and custom p.k when the spec round places it on the
target side. Multiplies SC_w after the weapon-side `sc_mul`; 02 E-2.5a (Melee Doughty) reads SC_w without it.
Tau's `1 + 0.1·n_TAU` is target state, not a group. Use `dot = "none"`. Addition, contract review DC-12.

NameKey.description: Key into `NameTable` (the UniqueName of the thing named).

OutcomeFilter.description:
Hit-outcome gate: the effect applies only to instances whose own rolls satisfy it (`{ crit = "none", status =
"none" }`). Procs of extra hits do not count. EV: the kernel adds the term only on the branch k = 0 with weight
P(k = 0)·P(no proc of the instance); MC: evaluated live after the rolls. A DSL construct of the architecture review
(work-breakdown.md §2.4, R-2): no 04 catalogue row uses it since 04's second tail round made Laetum Overwhelming
Attrition an on-hit buff whose trigger is [`TriggerId::OnPlainHit`] and which later instances use whatever their
own rolls (04 §5.12, D-410).

PartColumn.description: Column of a body part in `W:Enemy_Body_Parts` (05 §4.3).

`{ resolved = { stat = "sc_of.PUN", curve = { step = 0.10 } } }`.

n, the CO count (dynamic, class a; T-05).

The same value at every rank.

After the gains of the instance's own shot (04 §3.2 Double Tap).
Whole-magazine reload.

RivenClass.description: Riven class (09 E-9.50; `riv_class`). "none" is `Option::None` at the use site.

default_drain_at_max.description: ξ(8) assumed when the drain is not given (09 E-9.59: 18).

RivenLayoutRow.description: The layout factor L for (positives, negatives).

input.description: How the displayed value converts to model units (04 §8.2).

label.description: Label key; `None` = derived from the id.

pe_tag.description: Public Export `upgradeEntries` tag (value formula base b).

recipes.description: Splice recipes: pairs of consumed trait ids.

template.description: `None` = no damage effect (zoom, recoil). The riven value enters as the param `value`.

vintage_companion.description:
A vintage trait of companion rivens (09 §12.3: Zoom, Recoil, Ammo Maximum; the melee vintage traits): legal
when present on a companion riven, but riven generation (the optimizer's riven mode) MUST NOT produce it on
one. Addition, contract review API-12.

RivenUnit.description: How a riven trait value is typed (04 §8.2).

oneOf.description: `×y` → y − 1 (typed 1.45 → bonus 0.45).
Metres, seconds, counts: raw.

RoleFilter.description:
Attack-role part of a scope: the attack has any role of `any_of` (empty = any), none of `none_of`, and one of the
fire-mode `triggers` (empty = any).

any_of.description: The attack has one of these roles (empty = any).

none_of.description: The attack has none of these roles.

triggers.description:
The attack's trigger class (`FireSpec.trigger`, 06 §4.2) is one of these; empty = any (Critical Precision:
"Burst Fire Only", 04 §5.3). Addition, contract review DC-24.

Scope.description:
Static applicability of an effect, resolved per attack and hit kind at L1. TOML
`scope = { weapon = { slots = ["melee"] } }`, `scope = { attacks = { any_of = ["heavy"] } }`,
`scope = { hit = { body_part = ["weak_point"] } }`, `scope = { form = "normal" }`.

attacks.description: Attack roles the effect applies to.

hit.description: Damage instances the effect applies to.

factor.description: Factor on the value inside the sub-scope.

ShotPos.description: Shot position conditions (schedule-driven in every mode, 00 §6.2).

oneOf.description: The first shot of a magazine.
The last shot of a magazine.

min_base_magazine.description: Only on weapons whose base magazine is at least this (rounds; Synth Charge 6).

ShotType.description: Shot type of an attack (wiki `ShotType`, plus beams, discharges and melee strikes).

element_order.description:
Position in the element combination order of 01 §4.10.1 for `ElemOrder::Slot` elements of the item in this
slot: main slots 0-7, exilus 8, the weapon arcane slots and the Incarnon perk slots 9 (sub-index n of
`arcane<n>` and the evolution t (2-5) of `inc<t>`, E-1.8, so no two slots tie; contract review T03b-R2); `None`
= the slot cannot hold a combining `Slot` element (warframe slots: warframe-arcane elements use
`ElemOrder::WarframeArcane`, position 10). domain-model.md §13.

SlotKind.description: Content kinds of a slot (09 E-9.3).

SlotLayout.description: Slot layout of one equipment class (09 §2.2-2.3).

SniperComboSpec.description: Sniper combo data (06 E-6.16): `C_min` (`SniperComboMin`; `None` for reset-only weapons) and `D_snp`.

SpawnTemplate.description: Attack data of a spawned attack. An empty `base` means "the parent's per-type damage × `fraction`".

base.description: Base damage per type (Napalm: 150 Heat per tick).

can_crit.description: Whether the spawned attack can crit.

proc_duration.description: Status duration of the forced procs (Napalm Heat procs 3 s), when fixed.

radial.description: Whether it is a radial attack.

dps_dr.description:
05 §15.3 (Orphix): points `[X_dps, DR]`, X ascending, read with [`SpecialDrDef::dps_multiplier`] (the only
reading; CONTRACTS.md T03b review fixes). The interpolated quantity is the **effective DPS**
`g(X) = X·(1 − DR(X))`, not DR: g is linear between consecutive points, the last segment continues beyond the
last point, and M_dps(X) = g(X)/X (X ≤ the first point: 1 − DR of the first point). Linear in g is exactly
E-5.22's bands M = a + b/X; interpolating DR linearly is wrong inside every band and goes negative at high X.

SpecialDrFile.description:
`rules/special_dr.toml` (05 §4.4-4.5, §15; T03b): `[[dr]]` definitions and `[[enemy]]` hand rows keyed by
05 §4.1 ids.

Spool.description:
Auto-spool cadence (06 E-6.17): `S_sp` (data `Spool`), start fraction `s_sp`, step `Δ_sp` (fallback
`(1 − s_sp)/(S_sp − 1)` when absent).

start_frac.description: Start fraction s_sp of the fire rate.

SpotSource.description:
A weak-spot source σ of 02 E-2.10 (toggle T-32, spec 00 §6.1): the effect's value is the factor s_σ of one
highlighted node (Sonar 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 × Str by ability rank, Detect Vulnerability up to 2.75; 02 §4.10 "Weak
spots", 04 §5.6), and the two named params of the item hold the user's location L_σ and node count ν_σ, so the
T-32 inputs are `buffs[].params` of the scenario. The engine multiplies the sources as
`M_son = Π_σ s_σ^(ν_σ·spot_σ)` (not the "members add" rule of other groups), and a source with spot_σ = 1 on a
direct hit makes the instance a weak-point hit (domain-model.md §14). TOML
`spot = { location = "spot_location", nodes = "spot_nodes" }`. Addition, CONTRACTS.md T01d.

location.description:
Choice param of the item holding L_σ: `"hit_part"` (the T-03 part; the param's default) or `"torso"` (the
body part; reaches radial instances), 02 E-2.10.

nodes.description:
Number param of the item holding ν_σ ≥ 1 (the exponent of s_σ; Sonar default 1); `None` = one node
(Detect Vulnerability, "always 1", spec 00 §6.1 T-32).

StackModel.description:
Own stack counter of an effect (04 §4.2 field names and values). `consume_on`, `reset_on` and the `idle` decay
are 04 §4.2 fields added here (CONTRACTS.md, T01a). TOML
`stacks = { max = 2, bind_max = "n4", duration = 20.0, bind_duration = "n3", stack_timer = "shared_lose_one" }`.

duration.description:
Seconds at maximum rank; 0 = no expiry, in every class (E-4.9 with D = ∞): user-driven stacks of class (c)
and (u), and event-driven stacks without a stated timer (Strun Blazing Barrel, reset on reload; Critical
Precision; Arca Titron charges). Doc, contract review DC-21.

duration_rank.description:
Per-rank rule of `duration` (09 E-9.13 covers durations; X-RANK: Primary Plated Round
`{ table = [3.0, 4.0, 5.0, 6.0, 8.0, 10.0] }`, Double Tap `linear`). `None` = the same at every rank.

gain_on.description:
The gain event with its event filters, when it differs from the activity condition: then the effect's `when`
is the condition under which the stacks apply (evaluated at use) and this is the event that adds stacks
(Argon Scope: `when = { trigger = "while_aiming" }`, `gain_on = { trigger = "on_weak_point_hit" }`).
`None` = the effect's `when` is the gain event (domain-model.md §12.1). Its class joins the effect's derived
class. Addition, contract review DC-10.

max.description: Stack cap m at maximum rank; with `unbounded`, the default stack count of the user input instead.

max_rank.description:
Per-rank rule of `max` (09 E-9.13 covers stack caps; X-RANK: Double Tap's table 80, 40, 26, 20). `None` = the
same cap at every rank; `linear` = `max·(r + 1)/(R + 1)`; a table lists ranks 0 ..= R and its last entry
equals `max`. Addition (CONTRACTS.md, T01a fixes).

read.description:
When an instance reads the stacks (contract review DC-9): `before_instance` (default) is E-4.8's value(τ⁻)
(CD-04); `after_shot` counts the gains of the instance's own shot first, so every pellet of a shot reads the
count including that shot's hitting pellets (Double Tap, 04 §3.2: H includes this shot's hitting pellets;
TV-04-25).

unbounded.description:
No cap (04 §4.2 `max_stacks = none`, 04 §5.5 Magus Accelerant "no limit"): the effect is a class (c) or (u)
user count whose `CondOverride::Stacks` may exceed `max` (`max` is its default). Event-driven counters
without a cap are `counter_bonus` with `unbounded` (ruling C-4, CONTRACTS.md T01d).

StackTimer.description: Expiry rule of a stack counter (04 §4.2).

StanceCoRow.description: A row of table 9-D (07 §7.6): r_in per combo column; a cell holds one value for every input or one per input.

first_of_class.description: The class's first row, which carries the shared columns (E-7.21).

stance.description: Stance name as on the wiki page (the pipeline maps it to the stance item).

pattern.description: Anchored regex with a named group `v` for the value.

template.description: The effect without value (the line value enters as `{ param = "value" }`).

StatLineSuffix.description: A suffix that adds a scope factor (`(x2 for Bows)`).

StatLineUnit.description: How a stat-line value converts to model units.

oneOf.description: Raw number.

StatLinesFile.description:
`rules/stat_lines.toml` (pipeline.md §6.2 tier 1, 04 §5.1; T19): anchored stat-line patterns → effect
templates, scope suffixes and colour tokens.

StatusType.description: Status types, spec 00 §2.2 order: the damage types IMP … TAU plus Microwave, Knockdown, Lifted.

StatusesRepr.description: One status name or a set of statuses (readable `combined = "GAS"` or `combined = ["GAS", "VIR"]`).

oneOf.description:
The target carries a mark (Mecha set, 04 §9). Not simulated: true under `all_max`, under `simulated` the
effect's uptime (`EffectDef::uptime`, a `CondOverride`, default 1; domain-model.md §12.2).
The target is incapacitated. Not simulated: as `Marked`.
Health fraction below x (live only in the layered pass).

The scenario's target is an Eximus (05 §7, T-23; Eximus Advantage, 04 §5.3). Static per scenario: a gate,
evaluated in every mode and never assumed (derived class GATE). Addition, contract review DC-17.
A proc of one component of the combined status.

ToggleDescriptor.description: UI descriptor of a toggle (`data/curated/rules/toggles.toml`; server-api.md §5.6 `ScenarioSchema.toggles`).

default.description:
Default value in its JSON form (compact encoding: JSON text, because postcard is not self-describing).
Absent in a readable form = JSON `null` (TOML has no null, so `rules/toggles.toml` omits the key of an
off-by-default toggle; addition, CONTRACTS.md T03b).

field.description:
Path in `ScenarioDoc` (`"toggles.hit_location"`, `"eval.window_s"`); addition for server-api.md §5.6. The
place of the toggle in `TOGGLE_MAP`: several paths separated by `|`, `"buffs"` for the buff toggles (the
value is the buff pick's param `value`, rendered by the buffs panel), a `BuildDoc` path prefixed `build.` and
an optimizer-request path prefixed `opt.` (`rules/toggles.toml`, CONTRACTS.md T03b). A generic control
(every kind but [`ControlType::Custom`]) writes its value at the single path `field`. An `opt.` path belongs to
`OptRequest` and is never written by the calculator's panels (server-api.md §5.6), so such a toggle (T-36) is
`custom` (contract review T03b-R5).

ToggleGroup.description: Group of a toggle in the schema-driven panels (data: `"conditions"`, `"melee"`, `"enemy"` …).

Trigger.description:
Trigger class after the 06 §4.2 normalisation of the 33 wiki strings. `Duplex` is its own class DUPLEX: two shots
per trigger sequence (press and release, release gap 0), sequences at FR_trig with the semi cap (06 E-6.3, E-6.12;
D-608, whose compat path schedules it as SEMI per shot). `Active` schedules as SEMI and `AutoBurst` as BURST
(06 §4.2 table); they are kept distinct for compatibility rules (09 E-9.6: Duplex is not Semi-Auto) and display.

oneOf.description: The entry's `Hits`.
The attack's `Multishot`.

TriggerId.description:
Trigger ids of 04 §4.1: every (b) and (c) id of its table, plus `OnMeleeInput` and `OnThrow` (07 §7.5, §9.4).
`OnBigCrit`, `OnFire`, `OnMiss`, `OnDodge` and `HealthLevel` were added by T01a; `WhileFiring`, `OnPlainHit`,
`WhileAirborne`, `WhileCrouching`, `WhileMoving` and `OnPull` by T01d (CONTRACTS.md), appended after the T01a ids so
the compact form's variant indices stay unchanged. 04's `hits_within(k, Δt)` ("k hit units within Δt s": Final
Tap, Triple Tap, Sudden Justice) is `CountWithin { of: OnHit, n: k, window: Δt }`, the hits counted in the
`hit_unit` of the condition. TOML: `"on_kill"`, `"on_plain_hit"`, `{ on_status = "SLA" }`, `{ combo = 3 }`,
`{ count_within = { of = "on_headshot", n = 2, window = 2.0 } }`, `{ on_melee_input = "light" }`.

oneOf.description: Crit tier k ≥ 2.

`combo(c)` of 04 §4.1: the combo multiplier M(c) is at least n. A combo-state predicate read from the combo
model (07, or fixed by T-10) per instance, like `Per::ComboTier`: an effect conditioned on it derives the class
COMBO, not (b), so T-02 does not switch it off (Amanata Pressure's M(c) ≥ 8; domain-model.md §12.1). Doc,
contract review DC-24.
n events of `of` within `window` s (Phenmor Lingering Judgement: 2 headshots within 2 s); class (b).
Light / slide / aerial / wall input start (07 §7.5 `input_start`).
Glaive or thrown-weapon throw (07 §9.4).
(b) While the weapon fires (Flux Overdrive, 04 §5.3).

(b) A hit unit (the condition's `hit_unit`) in which no instance crits (k = 0) and no instance delivers a
status proc (04 §4.1; E-4.9 rate: hit units/s × Π over the unit's instances of P(k = 0)·P(no delivered proc |
k = 0), 08 E-8.15). Laetum Overwhelming Attrition (04 §5.12, D-410, TV-04-47).
(c) While airborne (Soaring Strike, 04 §5.3).
(c) While crouching (Lie In Wait, 04 §5.3).
(c) While moving (04 §4.1).
(c) Pulling an enemy with the alternate fire (Exposing Harpoon, 04 §5.3).

(b) `on_status(any)` of 04 §5.12: the instance delivers at least one status proc (π_any of 02 E-2.17; several
statuses in one hit count once). Gotva Prime passive. Addition, contract review DC-2.
s_j = Dmg/100.
s_j = 1 (the stance Dmg% is a consistency check).

Exalted waves (07 §9.8, E-7.43): light and slide waves (`combo_ranged` or `slide` trigger) are E-7.20 with
the strike's S_j on the Normal Attack; heavy waves (`heavy` trigger) are E-7.20b with H_j
(`B'_t = H_j·(Bw_t + V_t) + X_t`, `B_ref = H_j·B_ref`).

TypeSelRepr.description: Readable form of [`TypeSel`]: a list of type IDs or `{ param = "element" }`.

UniqueName.description:
Permanent identity of anything in the bundle. DE items use their DE path
(`"/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistol/AutoPistol"`). Things DE does not export use our namespace `"wfd:<kind>/<slug>"`,
e.g. `"wfd:buff/roar"`, `"wfd:enemy/grineer/lancer"`, `"wfd:perk/furis/haven_foray"`, `"wfd:custom/base"`,
`"wfd:shard/violet/primary_electricity"`. Enemies have synthetic names `wfd:enemy/<wiki sub-module>/<slug>`.

Upstream.description: `upstream = { field = "wiki.Description", text = "+165% Damage", sha256 = "9b1c…" }` (written by `curate rebind`).

UptimeSpec.description:
Default uptime of an effect's conditions ([`EffectDef::uptime`], 04 §4.3): on for `on` s in every `period` s.
TOML `uptime = { on = { scalar = "set_piece", values = [3.0, 6.0, 9.0, 12.0] }, period = { scalar = "set_piece",
values = [60.0, 45.0, 30.0, 15.0] } }` (the Mecha mark, 04 §9).

period.description: Period of one cycle (s); u = on/period.

ValueDecay.description: Value decay (04 §4.2): `linear` over the duration, `garuda` (04 §3.1), `idle` after `t_idle` s without a trigger.

rate.description: Value lost per second while decaying (fraction).

t_idle.description: Seconds without a trigger before the decay starts.

ValueTable.description:
Table form of [`ValueRepr`]: exactly one of the key groups `max` (+ `rank`, `bind`), `variants`, `param`,
`base` (+ `add`), `scalar` + `values`.

VulnMask.description:
Vulnerability mask: the damage types and layers a vulnerability multiplies (05 E-5.19). TOML
`vuln = { types = ["HEA"] }`, `vuln = { types = { param = "element" } }`,
`vuln = { types = ["PUN"], layers = ["OG", "SH", "HP"] }`.

Defaults follow the spec, not domain-model.md §11.1 ("layers default all"): a mask without `layers` applies to
health only (05 §13 "An entry without an explicit mask applies to health only (Decision)"; 04 §4.2 `layer_mask`
default `{HP}`, §5.7 "`{HP}` unless the U37 list above names it"), and a mask without `types` applies to every
type (04 §4.2 `type_mask` default `all`). Request C-14 of CONTRACTS.md.

layers.description: Layers the vulnerability applies to; default `{HP}` (not the all-layer default of [`LayerSet`]).

types.description: Damage types the vulnerability applies to; default every type.

WeaponClass.description:
Weapon class for effect scopes and riven classes (melee subclass: `MeleeData.class`).
`Crossbow`, `DualShotguns` and `Tome` are wiki classes named by spec 09 §3.1 (CONTRACTS.md, T01a).

WeaponFilter.description:
Weapon part of a scope. Empty lists accept every weapon. `melee_classes` and `traits` are additions for the
weapon-class scopes of 04 §4.2 (`weapon_class_scope`: glaive, battery, beam …; CONTRACTS.md, T01a).

none_traits.description:
The weapon must have none of these traits (Resupply: "not battery weapons", 04 §6.1). Addition, contract
review DC-24.

traits.description: The weapon must have every listed trait.

weapons.description:
Weapons named by uniqueName; empty = any. Like every list of the filter it is combined with the others by
"and" (Enraged: Hysteria only; Primal Rage: Iron Staff only; Excalibur's passive reaches Exalted Blade through
a second effect naming it; 04 §5.6). The names are data; the engine compares them with the weapon's uniqueName
(I-2). Addition, contract review DC-24.

WeaponOverrideFile.description:
`overrides/weapons/<slot>/<slug>.toml`: the hand tables of 06 §4.3 for one weapon and its innate passives
(owners T20, T21, T22, T29 by slot; read by T18). A hand entry overrides every generic data rule of 06 (06 §4.3
"Precedence"). Absent fields keep the data value. Parent links, roles, comb groups and the 02 §4.10 attack flags
are in [`AttackOverrideFile`]. Addition, contract review M-6, DC-18.

bow.description:
The weapon is a bow for 06's bow rules beyond `Class = Bow` (Artemis Bow, Artemis Bow Prime; 06 §5.1,
§11.3); maps onto `WeaponTraits::BOW` (contract review M-6).

magazine.description: Magazine and ammo mode (06 §5.6-5.7, 11.3 exalted ammo mode: infinite, magazine or battery).

passive.description:
Weapon-level innate effects appended to `Weapon.passives` (Gotva Prime, Sagek Prime, Arca Titron, Torid;
04 §5.12): `[[passive]]`.

reload.description:
Reload model: per-shell reload `{ per_shell = { start_end, per_shell } }` (06 §5.7), no-reload weapons
`"none"` (Epitaph, 06 §6.4).

volley.description: Volley groups by data `AttackName` (Arbucep "1st Attack" … "6th Attack"; 06 §6.8, E-6.14b).

WeaponSlot.description: Equipment slot of a weapon record.

XhPart.description: Body-part factor of an extra hit.

XhStatus.description: Status behaviour of an extra hit.
